notes.title: New mode was added: Endless Mode
notes.content:
Hello, today the Endless Mode was added.

[b]Endless Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Includes all Hitman Mode modifications, like [b]no horror events[/b] and [b]harder hitmen[/b].
[*] 4+ hitmen always generate with the hardest hitman pattern. In regular Hitman Mode, the hardest hitman pattern could spawn only after 45+ minutes in game.
[*] 4+ hitmen spawn much faster, so the player doesn't have to wait for the next hitman to spawn.
[*] Every 4+ hitman killed decreases the kill time for the next hitman by 5 seconds per his generated information.
[*] The player is allowed to have two browser instances open at the same time.
[*] There is a new achievement available, granted upon killing ten hitmen in Endless Mode.
[/list]

Additionaly, there are some other changes:
[list]
[*] [b]DeployAI:[/b] DeployAI now makes you immortal against hitmen as well. Previously, it only made you immortal against Stalkers & Demons. Keep in my mind completing the DeployAi app in Endless Mode will cause your run to finish.
[*] [b]Duplicate Information Bug:[/b] A small-chance bug causing same information to be shared between hitmen was fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: New mode was added: Hardcore Mode.
notes.content:
Hello, in today's patch I've added a Hardcore Mode.

[b]Hardcore Mode[/b]
Hardcore Mode has both the harder hitmen introduced in Hitman Mode and all of the horror events enabled. It additionally has following changes:[list]
[*] Player receives 20% less EXP.
[*] EasyLeads max. chance to scam is 30% + upgrades.
[*] EasyLeads gives the player 50% less credentials (you might be forced to buy the credentials needed for Checker at TheDarkHub.onion, find a thread that sells <200 since they're expensive.)
[*] Hardest hitman pattern spawns at 45+ min instead of 55+ min in Hitman Mode and 70+ min in Horror Mode.
[*] Player has only 45s instead of 60s to scare off Stalkers.
[/list][b]Additionaly, the Hardcore Mode has all the harder hitman modifications from the Hitman Mode:[/b][list]
[*] 30% less time to kill hitmen.
[*] Hitmen appear faster.
[*] Harder hitman patterns are able to generate earlier than in Horror Mode.
[/list]
Other, unrelated changes in this patch:
[list]
[*] [b]EasyLeads:[/b] EasyLeads upgrades would give you +2 credentials, but the upgrade description was "+1 credentials". This has been now fixed.
[*] [b]Web Browser Loading:[/b] The speed in which a page loads in was affected by current frame rate. It could vary by +/ 10%. Now it's the same no matter the fps.
[*] [b]Checker:[/b] After typing "y", the text field now clears.
[*] [b]Checker:[/b] Added hint that you can sell cracked accounts at TheDarkHub.onion.
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Normal mode was renamed to Horror Mode so the UI is consistent.
[/list]

notes.title: Menu and settings redesign + more graphic options.
notes.content:
Hello,

After adding some graphic settings in the last patch I've decided to stay up a bit more and redesign the whole menu since it was getting crowded and buttons barely fit. I've also tried to fix the resolution problem.

Changes list:
[list]
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] There is a new HARDCORE mode being planned, but there wasn't any place for it in the main menu. In this patch, the main menu was redesigned to enable adding more gameplay options.
[*] [b]Graphic Settings:[/b] In the last patch, there was a "Shadow Quality" graphic setting added. In this patch, I've added another two settings: reflections and global illumination. There are many other settings I could add, but after testing them ingame, changing them doesn't have any performance impact, so we'll probably stay with those three settings.
[*] [b]Resolution:[/b] I was able to reproduce a bug where I would get a very stretched game screen. This happened after putting the game in window mode, resizing it down, and then putting the game back in fullscreen mode. In this patch I've added a "resolution" setting where you should put your screen's resolution (please don't type anything silly like 500x600 or you might get softlocked lol). After filling in your screen resolution correctly, you can spam click any window mode and it should adjust properly.
[/list]

As always, if you have any feedback/suggestions, join our discord: [[url=https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU]invite[/url]]

notes.title: There is now a "Shadow Quality" setting available.
notes.content:
Hello,

I spent the rest of today's day to experiment with performance settings. XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX is a unique game as turning on/off the lights is it's main mechanic: unfortunately this means the lights have to be [b]dynamic[/b], which leads to a higher GPU usage. Most of the light you see in games are static lights (= they can't be turned on/off or change intensity/color), because static light is way more performant. Since we need the lights to change throughout the game, we have to stick with a lot of dynamic lights which make the game heavy. I'll be trying to optimize the game in the next couple days (hopefully I'll succeed). For now, a new "Shadow Quality" setting has been added:

[list]
[*] [b]Shadow Quality:[/b] There is a new shadow quality settings which should help players with low fps. It goes from 0 to 3, 0 being the lowest and 3 being the highest. I haven't really tested how the game looks on the lowest setting, so if you have some feedback, head over to our Discord ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU]invite[/url])
[*] [b]Chair Demon:[/b] If you walk into a demon, an attack minigame pops up. If you have more than 80 anxiety at that time, the minigame is unbeatable. There is an event where a demon sits on your chair: sometimes his collision would be bugged and still exists for ~0.5 second after he disappeared. This has been now fixed.
[*] [b]Brower Icon:[/b] Fixed a bug where you could avoid getting an anxiety hit by clicking the browser icon in the right moment and destroying your web browser.
[/list]

As a sidenote, the settings menu looks quite crowded now. Buttons barely fit in. I'll probably redesign it in the next patch.

notes.title: Fixed Insym bug
notes.content:
A quick patch for a bug found by a streamer/youtuber Insym, along with some other fixes:

[list]
[*] [b]Horror Events:[/b] When a minigame starts, it blocks all horror events from spawning since it would suck to get killed by a Stalker during a minigame. When the minigame is finished, the horror events are unlocked again. There was a bug related to this process: closing the minigame very fast using the mouse button just as it was completed had x% chance to make the horror events not unlock: this depended on the GarbageCollection cycle at the moment of closing the minigame and how fast it collected the destroyed minigame widget. This has been now fixed.
[*] [b]Checker:[/b] The message "I could buy this app to make money" added last patch was accidentaly displayed on LeakScanner.onion instead of Checker.onion. This has been now fixed.
[*] [b]Proxyware:[/b] Added minigame horror lock to the pushing update button.
[*] [b]HireAMurder:[/b] It seems that every new player/streamer simply refuses to fill in the "username" field of the person they're trying to kill on HireAMurder.onion. Before this patch, the resulting error would say "Not enough information" since you don't have any information on a person with "" as username. This error would make those poor new players come to the conclusion that they just need to dox some more information and they would venture back into TheHiddenWiki. I've added a special error for when trying to kill someone without filling in the username field.
[/list]

In this patch, the timer per information for +4 hitmans has been increased slightly.

tags.feature: [*] [b]Blogs:[/b] hackable blogs which give you EXP + ETH now only give you anxiety when you visit them for the first time. If you're busy doxing a hitman and tight on time, you can leave the blog, dox the hitman and then come back without suffering duplicate anxiety.

notes.title: 2023-03-18 Patchnotes
notes.content:
Hey, a new patch just went live. Here are the changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Horror events:[/b] wardrobe, door and toilet whisper events can no longer spawn after +20 min in game.
[*] [b]Horror events:[/b] made chair demon event appear more frequently after +20 min in game.
[*] [b]Horror events:[/b] made electricity shutdown event appear more frequently after +20 min in game.
[*] [b]Horror events:[/b] the demon on the bed now disappears instantly after lights are turned on.
[*] [b]Anxiety:[/b] being over >100 anxiety points now kills you instantly. Before this patch, it would sometimes give you ~30 seconds before death. The change is meant to help new players understand that they need to take pills before they reach 100 points: e.g sometimes a new player would be killed when he had 110 anxiety because of the delay and came to the false conclusion that 110 points is the limit.
[*] [b]EasyLeads:[/b] unlocking all EasyLeads upgrades makes it scam people automatically, without the need for the user to type any text. The automatic scamming was a bit slower than doing it manually. Now it's as fast as it can possibly get.
[*] [b]OSINT websites:[/b] DigitalIntelligence now displays a "Buy Query" button instead of "Top Up". All other sites talk about queries, so we made this one do it too to lessen any confusion a player might have.
[*] [b]Minigames:[/b] entering into a minigame was supposed to block any horror events from spawning until the minigame was solved. It was sometimes bugged and events still spawned. This has been now fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Fixed Cellbit bug
notes.content:
A quick fix for a bug found by a brazilian streamer:

[list]
[*] [b]Scanner app:[/b] after searching for an username, scanner app should give the information only if it's related to social media sites like LinkedIT or CryptoBros. When searching an username while the next information is something else, like a cryptocurrency address, the Scanner displays an error. However, despite displaying the error, it still adds the next information to DoxDocs. This has been now fixed and player is required go to through the normal route of looking up the information on various .onion pages.

[*] [b]Death screen:[/b] I also added a better death description when you die because of anxiety; now it directly says something along the lines "you died because you had >100 anxiety points" instead of a general recommendation to buy pills.
[/list]

notes.title: Small patchnotes 2023-03-16
notes.content:
Newest patchnotes contain quick fixes for the following:
[list]
[*] [b]Stair collision:[/b] if you crawled under the stairs and then stood up, your character would stand inside the stair mesh. Added collision preventing the player from going under the stairs to fix this.
[*] [b]DoxDocs App:[/b] if you typed random username and tried to add it to DoxDocs, it would add a duplicate of an already existing DoxDocs username. This bug worked only if you already had one username added to DoxDocs. Now it correctly rejects adding the user.
[*] [b]Savfiles created after death:[/b] as soon as you enter death screen, all your saves are deleted. But after spending >3 minutes in the death screen, the autosave system would make a new savefile with default values since it couldn't get real player data. Now the autosave system first checks whether player is dead.
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes 2023-03-15
notes.content:
Hello,

over the last few weeks we've been pushing various updates without putting them in any patchnotes announcement.

A quick shout-out to our Discord members which were active in the #feedback channel:
[list]
[*] Zombifr3d
[*] friendlyusername
[*] Maerman
[*] Capybara
[*] ravenswontdie
[*] ユニロニックシール
[*] mavi
[/list]
You can join our Discord using this link:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU]https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU[/url]

Here's the patchnotes list. You've probably already noticed some of the changes:
[list]
[*] Proxyware: added hint if extracting from Proxyware too early.
[*] Proxyware: added hint about earning money when visiting Proxyware.onion for the first time.
[*] Death screen: added different death screens depending whether you've died to demon stacks or to walking into a demon (previously you received the same death screen & information which confused some players about the cause of their death).
[*] Death screen: added different death screens depending whether you've died to stalker stacks or to failing to scare off a stalker (previously you received the same death screen & information which confused some players about the cause of their death).
[*] Death screen: made demon/stalker information more clear: now it directly says how the demon/stalkers stacks work.
[*] Added "app installed" pop-up after talking to proxyware co-admin (some people didn't notice new app on their PC)
[*] Fixed death cutscene which kills you after having >100 anxiety points. The cutscene is a demon turning off the lights; sometimes it would bug out and the light would be already turned off at the beginning.
[*] Added "Game Wiki" button in the ESC in-game menu which opens up the game wiki for you to read if you're confused about a mechanic.
[*] Updated in-desktop help notes.
[*] EasyLeads: added a hint message which appears after manually writing three leads, saying you can ctrl+c ctrl+v the text instead of writing.
[*] Improved the website which shows up after typing an onion link in the browser: now it tells you directly to go to TheHiddenWiki (some people have read the help notes first and tried going to AlphaMedicine.onion at the beginning).
[*] Added info to the in-desktop notes that anxiety pills relieve your anxiety by 50% (so people know it's better to wait for high anxiety before consuming them)
[*] Added hint when there are more than three demon stacks and they start attacking you. The hint tells the player to "turn on the lights for couple minutes".
[*] Added hint that you need to "look around from time to time to scare off stalkers" in various places.
[*] Added "Skip Start" option in the main menu which appears after you've died and skips KappaMeister/BlueEyes dialogues and the "take pills" and "visit thedarkhub" quests as well.
[*] Fixed the window stalkers: the one in the middle was using the animation of the stalker on the left, which made him look goofy.
[/list]
